# Max K Media

> Max K Media is a one-person studio in Bathurst, NSW, Australia, run by Max Krause. It builds websites and online stores, shoots commercial photography and video, and does industrial automation work (PLC and SCADA) for businesses across the Central West of NSW.

Contact: 0490 365 553, max@maxkmedia.com. ABN 47 419 910 441.

## Main pages
- [Web Design, Photography & Automation Bathurst](https://maxkmedia.com/): Websites, online stores, SEO, commercial photography, video and control systems from one studio in Bathurst, serving Orange, Mudgee, Dubbo and the Central West.
- [Web Design & Development Bathurst, Central West NSW](https://maxkmedia.com/web.html): Web design, development, online stores and SEO for Bathurst and Central West businesses. Hand-built, fast on phones, and moved without losing rankings.

- [Website & IT Support Bathurst](https://maxkmedia.com/support.html): Website maintenance, small-office IT and control system support in Bathurst and the Central West. Monthly plans tailored to what you run, or by the hour.
